title: Give a streamed Anthropic tool call without arguments an empty input hash

files.patch:
@@ -10,6 +10,7 @@
 - [SECURITY]: A change which fixes a security vulnerability.
 
 ## [Unreleased]
+- [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1059] Give a streamed `Langchain::LLM::Anthropic` tool call without arguments `input: {}` instead of `nil`, which made `Langchain::Assistant` end the run in `:failed` with streaming on.
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1057] Rebuild `thinking` and `redacted_thinking` blocks in streamed `Langchain::LLM::Anthropic#chat` responses instead of leaving `nil` in the content, which made `chat_completion` raise `NoMethodError` whenever Claude thought (by default on Claude 5 models).
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1056] Format `PromptTemplate` and the `FewShotPromptTemplate` suffix in a single pass, so escaped `{{braces}}` stay literal, an inserted value is never expanded as another variable, and backslashes in values (`\'`, `\0`, `\&`) are kept as-is.
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1055] Stop sending the default `temperature` (0.0) from `Langchain::LLM::Anthropic#chat`; Claude Opus 4.7+ and Sonnet 5+ reject it with a 400. A temperature set in `default_options` or passed to `#chat` is still sent.

@@ -193,7 +193,10 @@ def tool_calls_from_choice_chunks(chunks)
           id: first_block.dig("content_block", "id"),
           type: "tool_use",

-          input: input.empty? ? nil : JSON.parse(input).transform_keys(&:to_sym)
+          # A tool without arguments streams an empty partial_json; the non-streamed
+          # response (and AwsBedrock's streamed one) gives {} for it, and the Assistant
+          # and the replayed tool_use block both need a hash.
+          input: input.empty? ? {} : JSON.parse(input).transform_keys(&:to_sym)
         }
       end.compact
     end

+    describe "#run with a streamed tool call that takes no arguments" do
+      let(:clock) do
+        # Named before define_function runs, since the tool name comes from the class name
+        clock_class = stub_const("WallClock", Class.new do
+          extend Langchain::ToolDefinition
+
+          def now
+            "12:00"
+          end
+        end)
+        clock_class.define_function :now, description: "Returns the current time"
+        clock_class.new
+      end
+      let(:tool_call_chunks) do
+        [
+          {"type" => "message_start", "message" => {"id" => "msg_1", "role" => "assistant", "model" => "claude-sonnet-4-6", "content" => []}},
+          {"type" => "content_block_start", "index" => 0, "content_block" => {"type" => "tool_use", "id" => "toolu_1", "name" => "wall_clock__now", "input" => {}}},
+          {"type" => "content_block_delta", "index" => 0, "delta" => {"type" => "input_json_delta", "partial_json" => ""}},
+          {"type" => "content_block_stop", "index" => 0},
+          {"type" => "message_delta", "delta" => {"stop_reason" => "tool_use"}, "usage" => {"output_tokens" => 10}}
+        ]
+      end
+      let(:final_chunks) do
+        [
+          {"type" => "message_start", "message" => {"id" => "msg_2", "role" => "assistant", "model" => "claude-sonnet-4-6", "content" => []}},
+          {"type" => "content_block_start", "index" => 0, "content_block" => {"type" => "text", "text" => ""}},
+          {"type" => "content_block_delta", "index" => 0, "delta" => {"type" => "text_delta", "text" => "It's 12:00."}},
+          {"type" => "content_block_stop", "index" => 0},
+          {"type" => "message_delta", "delta" => {"stop_reason" => "end_turn"}, "usage" => {"output_tokens" => 5}}
+        ]
+      end
+
+      subject { described_class.new(llm: llm, tools: [clock]) { |_chunk| } }
+
+      it "runs the tool and sends its tool_use block back with an empty input hash" do
+        sent = []
+        allow(llm.client.messages).to receive(:create) do |parameters|
+          sent << parameters[:messages]
+          ((sent.size == 1) ? tool_call_chunks : final_chunks).each { |chunk| parameters[:stream].call(chunk) }
+        end
+
+        subject.add_message(role: "user", content: "What time is it?")
+        subject.run(auto_tool_execution: true)
+
+        expect(subject.state).to eq(:completed)
+        expect(subject.messages.last.content).to eq("It's 12:00.")
+        expect(sent.last[1][:content]).to eq([{id: "toolu_1", type: "tool_use", name: "wall_clock__now", input: {}}])
+        expect(sent.last[2][:content].first).to include(type: "tool_result", tool_use_id: "toolu_1", content: "12:00")
+      end
+    end
+
